verdicts.reason: A keeps the diamond mosaic and both brown badges, and the headline, rule and body copy stay grouped as in the original. Its flaws are a hard flat crop on the photo band, large dead white bands above and below, and small body and vertical URL text. B breaks the mosaic: the diamond layout is distorted with empty white holes, stray ghost slivers sit at the bottom edge, and the address badge floats loose. The rule also detaches from the headline and sits on the body copy, leaving a big gap under the headline. B is clearly less faithful and less intentional.
